title: `topics/personal-identity` The Standard Positions misdescribes two rivals and omits a third — L67 animalism "neither is you because the organism ceased" (standard animalism: you stay behind with the organism), L69 "You are your story" casts Schechtman's characterization-question view as a reidentification criterion, and no-self has no place among the positions; diachronic-agency-and-personal-narrative links here but is never linked back
